title: Scan for Wi-Fi networks using iwctl
summary: Use iwctl to scan for available Wi-Fi networks and list them. This is useful when you need to see what networks are in range without using a graphical interface.
prerequisites: You know your Wi-Fi interface name (station)

steps.explain: Start a scan for Wi-Fi networks using your Wi-Fi interface (station).

placeholders.name: STATION
placeholders.description: The name of your Wi-Fi interface, e.g., wlan0 or phy0

steps.explain: Display the list of networks found by the scan.
